output.headline: Passes the rules, but at [[S-per-head]] a head it's above the usual rate, so consider trimming toward the suggested amount.

reasons.text: The request works out to [[S-per-head]] per RSVP, above the C-03 target of [[S-target-per-head]] and above the recent average of [[S-recent-avg-per-head]] across similar approvals.
Past pizza GMs with similar headcounts were approved near target, e.g. P-14 (14 attendees, treasurer said 'right on target'). The suggested amount at C-03 is [[S-suggested]].
The org is saying that 14 RSVPs are confirmed, and walk-ins are expected. C-02 says to order to RSVPs and let leftovers cover walk-ins, so the walk-in interest doesn't justify going over target.

The board wants regular GMs near the usual rate to protect the reserve, though recruiting GMs are decided case by case. The request leaves [[S-above-reserve-after]] above the C-04 reserve, so it's not at risk, but nothing here sets a recruiting exception.
